answer: Last month one grader approved 200 answers in 40 minutes and nobody caught it, because the same address held every seat. Now each review is split across 3 independent auditors, each staking 25 POA, and 5% of tasks are spot-checked by a fourth. Trust sits on the task, not the address, so a new account inherits nothing. Cost of that grader's replacement: 75 POA per task in stakes and a re-run every 20 tasks. The river of approvals slows and a voyage through 200 tasks needs 600 signatures, while the vault pays only for checked work.
